mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and have cardiotoxic effects; mefloquine inhibits CYP3A4, increasing quinidine levels, and both have class I antiarrhythmic properties that may be additive, creating significant risk for torsades de pointes and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval closely, and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of quinidine levels.
